purpose: Consult before retrieving a source. Records what an agent found when it inspected a domain's robots file and terms, so the same check is not repeated by every author and so an exclusion one author discovered is not missed by the next. A verdict here does not replace the per-source check the rights policy requires; it tells you what was found before, and when. Re-verify anything older than the recheckAfterDays below, and append a domain the first time you check it.

domains.evidence: Terms page states the illustrations are free for any use, including educational, research, informational and commercial purposes, and directs the user to the licence on each entry for attribution requirements. No account needed. No robots.txt served.
domains.notes: Licence is per entry; sampled entries are labelled Public Domain. Record the per-entry label every time. Suggested credit form: Illustration from NIAID NIH BioArt Source (bioart.niaid.nih.gov/bioart/###).

domains.evidence: Licences are stated per icon and span CC0, CC BY 3.0, CC BY 4.0, CC BY-SA, MIT and BSD.
domains.notes: Only CC0 and CC BY 4.0 items qualify. CC BY 3.0 items are rejected as well as the share-alike ones.

domains.evidence: /wiki/File: and /wiki/Category: are crawlable; the /w/ API path is disallowed to crawlers but is a documented programmatic interface and was used with a descriptive User-Agent for licence lookup only, with every result confirmed on the human file page.
domains.notes: Licences are per file and most cell-biology diagrams are CC BY-SA, which this project rejects. Usable only for the CC0 and public-domain seam. Never a source for artwork whose creator has a canonical site of their own.

domains.notes: robots permits the chapter paths; the prohibition is in the terms, not robots. Found only by reading the terms.
